calls.statement:
WITH web_sales AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date AS d, f.net_amount AS sales, 0 AS refunds
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  WHERE s.store_id = 900
), web_returns AS (
  SELECT r.return_date AS d, 0 AS sales, r.refund_net AS refunds
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  WHERE s.store_id = 900
), u AS (SELECT * FROM web_sales UNION ALL SELECT * FROM web_returns)
SELECT c.fiscal_year, c.fiscal_period, sum(u.sales) AS sales_before_returns, sum(u.refunds) AS returns_net, sum(u.sales) - sum(u.refunds) AS net_sales
FROM u JOIN ref_fiscal_calendar c ON u.d BETWEEN c.period_start_date AND c.period_end_date
WHERE c.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND c.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2

SELECT c.fiscal_period, sum(r.net_sales_before_returns) b, sum(r.returns_net) rn, sum(r.net_sales) ns
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN ref_fiscal_calendar c ON r.business_date BETWEEN c.period_start_date AND c.period_end_date
WHERE r.store_id=900 AND c.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND c.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT c.fiscal_period, sum(CASE WHEN rs.store_id=900 THEN r.refund_net ELSE 0 END) web_booked, sum(CASE WHEN rs.store_id<>900 THEN r.refund_net ELSE 0 END) store_booked
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_store rs ON rs.store_key=r.store_key
JOIN ref_fiscal_calendar c ON r.return_date BETWEEN c.period_start_date AND c.period_end_date
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND c.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND c.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
